title: Complexe de De Rham à puissance divisée [conférence de 1976 à l’IHÉS] : notes manuscrites (s.d.).

deep.reconstruction:
This page is not part of the divided-power de Rham notes around it. It is a typescript page, numbered '- 186 -' and headed 'IX', from Grothendieck's SGA 7 I, Exposé IX ('Modèles de Néron et monodromie'), §13. That section treats the complex-analytic (transcendental) case of the monodromy theory of Néron models; the page was evidently filed into this folder.

Setting: S is a small complex-analytic disc around a point s, written 0. A is a relative commutative analytic group over S coming from a separated group scheme, and A^o is its 'connected component'. A^o is uniformized as Lie(A)/R, where R is the sheaf of lattices (the kernel of the exponential), a sheaf on S that is a local system over the punctured disc.

- (13.5.5) The n-torsion of A^o is identified with R⊗Z/nZ.
- (13.5.6) Passing to the limit over n = ℓ^{k+1} gives T_ℓ(A^o) ≅ R⊗Z_ℓ as projective systems of groups over S.
- (13.5.7) Because A comes from a separated group scheme, each R⊗Z/n is representable by a relative scheme. So the fibre (R⊗Z_ℓ)_0 at the special point makes sense, even though R_0 itself would not in general (the étale space of R is badly behaved at 0). This yields a canonical isomorphism T_ℓ(A_0) ≅ (R⊗Z_ℓ)_0.
- (13.5.8) By the constructions of §2 and 13.3, this isomorphism respects the filtrations: the fixed (monodromy-invariant) part goes to R^f⊗Z_ℓ and the toric part to R^t⊗Z_ℓ.
- The page then starts the comparison of pairings. Take a second such group A' and a biextension W_0 of (A_0, A'_0) by G_m. It extends over a neighbourhood of s to an analytic biextension W of (A, A') by G_m (working on the analytic site). By VIII 2.2, W defines pairings on the ℓ-adic and lattice data.

The purpose is to identify Grothendieck's ℓ-adic monodromy pairing with the transcendental pairing on the lattice R. This is the classical-topology check of the algebraic theory of Néron models, semistable reduction and the monodromy pairing.

ideas.what: Torsion and Tate module of a relative analytic group expressed via its lattice of periods R: _nA^o ≅ R⊗Z/n, T_ℓ ≅ R⊗Z_ℓ, specialised to the special fibre
ideas.modern_name: Uniformization / period lattice description of the Tate module in a degenerating family

ideas.what: Compatibility of fixed and toric parts of T_ℓ with those of R
ideas.modern_name: Weight/monodromy filtration on the Tate module (fixed part, toric part)

ideas.what: Analytic biextension extending W_0, giving pairings via VIII 2.2: comparison of the ℓ-adic monodromy pairing with the transcendental one
ideas.modern_name: Monodromy pairing (Grothendieck's pairing) and its transcendental description
ideas.where_published: SGA 7 I, Exp. VIII 2.2 and IX §13

deep.surprise_reason: The page is a typescript page of SGA 7 I, Exposé IX §13, which was published in 1972. It is an archival misfiling inside the divided-power de Rham notes and contains nothing that is not already in print.
transcription_corrections: The page is the SGA 7 IX typescript (page 186), not part of the manuscript notes on divided-power de Rham complexes.
The original typescript reads 'ieomorphisme' (a typing error for 'isomorphisme') in the line before 13.5.6.
In 13.5.7 a small handwritten mark sits above the ≃ sign.
